verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Crossmint acting as a client of x402 and MPP endpoints and exposing its own REST APIs, but nothing establishes that either protocol is an open, versioned specification. Nor does Crossmint publish its own commerce protocol spec that developers can implement without signing up; the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path. Supporting third-party protocols, without evidence of their openness or versioning, does not meet the story.
